There are two error codes that can only appear on the AQ-200 Pro
1
:
E08 – VOC sensor failure: Indicates that the VOC sensor is not responding
1
. The fix is to restart the unit; if the code persists, the VOC sensor module (SN-VOC, $29 USD) must be replaced
1
2
. (The AQ-200 Pro is the only model equipped with a VOC sensor
3
.)
E13 – UV-C lamp fault: Indicates that the UV-C lamp module has reached the end of its life or is disconnected
1
. The fix is to replace the UV-C lamp module (UV-200, $35 USD)
1
2
. The purifier continues filtering air even while the UV-C lamp is inactive
1
. (The Pro is the only model that features UV-C sterilization
3
.)
(Note: While E11 for Wi-Fi connection failure and E12 for firmware update failure do not appear on the Lite, they apply to both the standard AQ-200 and the AQ-200 Pro
1
.)
